vulnerable_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # CanCanCan bug: block condition cannot be translated to SQL by accessible_by.
    # When Document.accessible_by(current_ability) is executed in controllers,
    # the block is ignored and ALL records are returned without WHERE filtering!
    can :read, Document do |doc|
      doc.organization_id == user.organization_id
    end
  end
end

class DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @documents = Document.accessible_by(current_ability)
    render json: @documents
  end
end
diagnosis: Defining CanCanCan rules using Ruby blocks prevents the library from compiling SQL conditions when calling accessible_by in index actions. The database executes an unfiltered SELECT * query, leaking confidential corporate documents from all organizations to any authenticated user.

corrected_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # Use hash conditions so CanCanCan can construct valid SQL queries for accessible_by
    can :read, Document, organization_id: user.organization_id
  end
end

class DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @documents = Document.accessible_by(current_ability)
    render json: @documents
  end
end
